extensionDescription.message: Live Binance/OKX copy-trader risk analysis from the current lead page.

popupUsageBody.message: Open a Binance or OKX lead-trader detail page. The analysis panel appears automatically and computes risk locally from data visible to your current browser session.

popupCheckMartingale.message: Martingale-like adverse adds and long loss holds

popupCheckMargin.message: Loss-period capital injections and current floating-loss risk

popupCheckPayoff.message: Payoff ratio, expectancy, sample size, and MDD

popupCheckScalping.message: Slippage and copyability risk in high-frequency micro-profit strategies

popupPrivacyBody.message: No collection, upload, storage of cookies, headers, API keys, or account data. There is no backend service.

settingNoCopyExisting.message: Do not copy existing positions; wait for the next new entry.

settingSmallRatio.message: If you still want to test it, use a small fixed-ratio allocation and an account-level stop loss.

settingHighMdd.message: MDD is high; avoid oversizing a single lead trader.

settingDefault.message: Use fixed-ratio copy, avoid copying existing positions, and set an account-level stop loss.

loadingText.message: Fetching current public/session-visible data and analyzing locally. Temporary busy pages are retried until complete.

noMajorRisks.message: No major risk rule triggered, but this does not mean the trader is safe or profitable.

noPositives.message: Not enough positive evidence yet; observe more samples first.

disclaimer.message: This analysis only uses data available to the current browser session and computes locally. It is not investment advice and does not guarantee profit or safety.

familyInsufficient.message: Not enough trade history to judge copy risk

familyMartingale.message: Martingale: each add against the position is a fixed multiple of the last, so a run of wrong-way moves grows the loss geometrically

familyGrid.message: Grid: fixed-size orders on evenly spaced levels, each closed a level away; a one-way trend keeps adding inventory

familyDcaNoStop.message: Averaging in without stops: adds while losing and almost never takes a loss, so one sustained move can wipe out many small wins

familyDcaWithStop.message: Averaging in with stops: adds while losing but does realise losing positions

familyShortTerm.message: Short-term trading: most positions are held under a day, so copier latency and fees weigh more

familySwing.message: Swing trading: longer holds, so copiers may inherit open-position volatility

labelHighWinTailRisk.message: High win rate may hide tail risk

labelNeverRealisedLoss.message: Never closed a position at a loss

verdictHighRiskAvoid.message: High risk; not suitable for normal copy trading

verdictAggressiveGrowth.message: Aggressive growth candidate (regular profit withdrawals recommended)

positiveHighCopierProfit.message: Copiers have made a cumulative real net profit of {0}, demonstrating strong real-world alpha.

positiveDays.message: Trading days are about {0}, meeting the minimum 30-day observation threshold.

positiveClosedTrades.message: {0} closed trades are available, enough for an initial behavior read.

positivePayoff.message: Average payoff ratio is {0}, not a typical small-win/large-loss profile.

positiveLossHoldShort.message: Average losing trades are held for less time than winning trades, suggesting cleaner stop behavior.

cautionTooFewDays.message: Trading days are only {0}; this is below the minimum 30-day observation threshold.

cautionNoAllPeriodRoi.message: All-period ROI cannot be reconstructed reliably; do not rely only on a partial page window.

cautionReconstructedNeedsCompleteness.message: All-period ROI is reconstructed from available data; history completeness and starting point still matter.

cautionThinClosedTrades.message: Only {0} closed trades are available; one trade can heavily distort the conclusion.

cautionHighMdd.message: Visible/API MDD is about {0}; a new copier could immediately suffer a large drawdown.

cautionLongLossHold.message: The longest historical losing position was held for {0}, indicating dead-loss holding risk.

cautionPoorPayoff.message: Average payoff ratio is only {0}, meaning average losses are larger than average wins.

cautionNearPerfectWin.message: Win rate is near 100% with almost no realized losses; the strategy may not have been stress-tested.

cautionMicroProfit.message: High-frequency micro-profit strategies can be consumed by copy latency, slippage, and fees.

cautionAdverseAdd.message: Adverse add rate is about {0}; exposure grows when the market moves against the position.

cautionLossPeriodDeposit.message: Detected {0} capital injections during losing positions; copiers may not be able to add margin synchronously.

cautionFloatingLoss.message: Current positions show about {0} floating loss, roughly {1}% of lead capital.

cautionCopierDivergence.message: Lead ROI is positive, but copier PnL/AUM is about {0}; slippage, entry timing, or position management may diverge.

cautionCloseLeadCount.message: Historical closures: {0}. Old performance and current-round data may be disconnected.

cautionPreStartHistory.message: Detected trade history predating the official start date by {0} days — bleed-through from a prior, closed lead portfolio. Behaviour stats (win rate, payoff, holding time) already exclude those rows; all-period ROI and drawdown still include them, so the two are on different calibers.

evidenceLossDeposit.message: Capital injections during loss periods are one of the hardest risks for copiers to reproduce.

evidenceDestructiveMartingale.message: Adverse adds, delayed loss exits, or payoff imbalance appear together; martingale-like tail risk is high.

evidenceFloatingLoss.message: There is a material floating-loss position now; a new copier may inherit risk that was not theirs.

evidenceHugeMdd.message: Historical drawdown is very large. This only fits tiny speculative allocation, if any.

evidenceAggressiveGrowth.message: Copiers have achieved substantial real profits without rescue deposits. Despite high historical drawdown, this demonstrates high aggressive alpha; recommend small allocation with regular profit withdrawals.

evidenceCopierBleed.message: Copiers suffer heavy cumulative losses or severe divergence from lead ROI; high slippage, excessive stop-outs, or toxic execution risk.

cautionSevereDeadLoss.message: Max loss hold was {0}, showing severe stubborn holding habits.

evidenceExtremeDeadLoss.message: History of holding dead losses for over 12 days, extremely vulnerable to liquidation during trends.

cautionStagnantMomentum.message: Recent 30D ROI is only {0} with very low trade frequency ({1} trades/day), indicating momentum decay.

cautionHighInitialLeverage.message: Initial order leverage is {0}x with frequent adverse adds, creating severe liquidation risk.

evidenceZeroLossMartingaleBomb.message: Never closes losing trades (100% win-rate illusion) with deep adverse laddering, posing extreme liquidation risk.

cautionZeroLossMartingaleBomb.message: Historical win rate is 100% (0 stopped losses), but adverse adds reach {0} layers — classic refusing-to-cut-loss tail risk bomb.

posTitle.message: What {0} is actually holding right now

posSubtitle.message: This trader set their positions to private, so normally you would have to copy them to see any of this. Their fills stayed public, and the book below was rebuilt from those fills.

posEmpty.message: Rebuilt from their fills, this trader is currently flat — nothing open.

posDisclaimer.message: Third-party reconstruction for research only. Not investment advice and not official Binance data.

posLeverageInferredHint.message: This position does not disclose its leverage, so the leverage from this symbol's most recent closed position is used instead.

posLeverageUnknownHint.message: Neither this position nor the symbol's history carries a leverage, so margin and ROI cannot be computed.

posLeverageReadHint.message: Leverage read straight from the exchange's record for this position.

posNoLadder.message: No fill-level history is available for this position.

posNoteOrderDepthLimited.message: The exchange returned {0} of a claimed {1} fills, so older entries may be invisible.

posNotePositionDepthLimited.message: The exchange's position history came back incomplete, so some older positions may be missing.

posNoteEstimatedRows.message: {0} position(s) have no usable fills; their size is marked “≈” and may be larger than shown.

posNoteMissingMarks.message: No mark price available for: {0} — their unrealized PnL is left blank.

posNoteNotDerivable.message: Not derivable from public data: liquidation price, accrued funding, isolated-margin allocation.

posLoadingHint.message: This trader set their positions to private, so normally you would have to copy them to see any of this. Reading their public fill history to rebuild the book.

posConfidenceSizeUnknownHint.message: Binance still lists this position as open, but the two numbers it publishes (peak size and closed volume) cannot yield a remainder after repeated closing and re-entering. Left blank rather than guessed, and reported rather than hidden.

posNoteTruncatedHistory.message: The exchange only served fills back to {0}, yet dates its own oldest position to {1} — the fills in between are invisible, so any position with no closed position to anchor on is marked as having incomplete fills.

posNotePartialFillRows.message: {0} position(s) are missing their opening fills; their size is marked “≥” and is a floor, not the actual figure.

posBadgeAtLeastHint.message: Binance did not serve the fills that opened this position, so this is a floor — what the trader actually holds can only be more than this, never less.

posBadgeApproxHint.message: No fills are available for this position at all, so the size is Binance's published peak size minus its closed volume. If the trader scaled back in after closing part of it, this reads low.

posQtySourceExact.message: Netted from every fill, and it agrees with Binance's own totals

posQtySourceReconciled.message: Netted from every fill, plus the {0} units of opening volume Binance left out of its own fill history

posQtySourcePartial.message: Netted from every fill, but Binance did not serve the fills that opened this position, so this is only a floor

posQtySourceEstimated.message: Binance's published peak size {0} minus its closed volume {1}

posQtySourceUnknown.message: Binance's published peak size {0} is below its closed volume {1} (repeated closing and re-entering), so no remainder can be derived

gapItem.message: {0} could not be fully retrieved, so this risk cannot be judged and no copy recommendation is given.

familyIncompleteData.message: Incomplete data — strategy type cannot be judged
